overview: Brad Upton has spent decades finding the funny in getting older. In CODE BLUE, he may have more material than ever.  From pill caddies and bad drivers to marriage, kids, generational differences and the indignities that come with aging, Brad brings his sharp, boomer perspective to an hour of comedy about a life well lived—and a body that occasionally has other plans.  Behind the laughs is a deeply personal story that gave Brad a new appreciation for taking life as it comes, enjoying the ride and finding humor even when things don’t go according to plan.  Funny, personal and unexpectedly heartfelt, CODE BLUE is Brad Upton at his best: laughing at life, aging on his own terms and proving there’s always something worth finding funny along the way.
